selection_rationale: Exactly one narrow survivor remains from each user-prioritized direction. M809R3-01 retains one global irrational remainder and therefore avoids the disproved unweighted and per-cut rounding formulations. M809R3-05 asks for rank in the actual graph-realizable low/high exchange graph, so the round-two scalar counterprofile is a hypothesis miss. M809R3-08 is the only carrier-creation proposal not already reduced to a false one-step map: it requires a genuine alternating path to a new carrier. None is proved, and none changes the 1/8 main term.
chain_firewall: M809R3-01 must prove one strict integer margin globally, not once per circuit.
M809R3-05 must construct actual exchange arcs and distinct C7-compatible outputs.
M809R3-08 must terminate at a previously unused actual carrier and prove nonreuse across circuits.
Even all three conditional statements together do not count until every hard public branch is composed.
